ShortDescription.Value: A control tower for your airports: one airplane per runway, holding, line up and wait, pushback, airspace and radio.

Publish.LongDescription:
Realistic Aviation gives every airport a control tower that runs its runways the way real ones do.
- One airplane per runway: departures hold short, arrivals in the air fly a holding pattern until cleared. The runway goes to whoever has waited longest relative to how quickly they use it, so nobody waits forever. - Arrival sequencing with spacing and wake turbulence separation; departures slot in between arrivals. - Go-arounds at 100 ft when the runway is not clear (and now and then in rain or snow), followed by a traffic pattern. - Line up and wait (on at class B and C airports), pushback from nose-in gates, taxi spacing, gate holds. - Airport closures for tornadoes, hail and other disasters near a runway. - Airspace classes B, C and D with approach, departure, tower and ground frequencies, handoffs between airports, and an airspace infoview. - Radio in standard ICAO/FAA English phraseology in the airport and airplane info panels ("Runway 09, cleared to land"). - Runway numbers from each runway's heading (09, 27L, ...).
Every option and per-airport setting is in the options menu or the airport's info panel. In-game text is in English and Korean.
The per-airport choices are saved with the city. Removing the mod is safe: the save still loads and those choices are simply dropped.
Made with AI: this mod was vibe-coded with Claude by Anthropic. Claude (Claude Code) wrote all the code; Boing787 directed the work and tested it in-game.
Source code (MIT): https://github.com/kanghyeon01/realistic-aviation
